title: Multiple clusters: multi-context, federation and region strategy

videos.script: Every cluster in this course was one cluster. Most companies that run Kubernetes run several: one per environment, one per region, sometimes one per team. {{many}} Nothing in Kubernetes joins them. Two clusters are two API servers, two etcds, two sets of names, and the only place they meet is the file on your laptop that knows the address of each. {{apart}} You will run two clusters side by side, deploy the same application to both, delete it from the wrong one on purpose, and then look at what people build when they need clusters to act together. {{plan}}
